headlines.title: Colts lock up Adebawore as the rebuild starts
headlines.summary: The Colts have agreed to a two-year, $35 million extension with defensive tackle Adetomiwa Adebawore, including a $13 million signing bonus and $22.5 million in new money through 2027. He has four sacks in eight games, already matching his career high. The Colts are 2–6 and fired general manager Chris Ballard earlier this month. They have already traded Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner, and ESPN and NFL Network report trade talks over running back Jonathan Taylor.
headlines.whyItMatters: Keeping a young pass rusher is a rare positive for a team in rebuild mode, and the trade deadline on November 10 could bring more moves.

headlines.title: Saints cut Carlson after another missed kick

The Saints have claimed running back Audric Estime off waivers, and they face the Browns on Sunday.
headlines.whyItMatters: At 2–5 and 15th in the NFC, the Saints need a reliable kicker quickly.

headlines.title: Grizzlies' unbeaten start ends in overtime
headlines.summary: Memphis had been 6–0 and the only unbeaten team in the league. New Orleans beat them 135–134 in overtime, with Zion Williamson scoring 25 points and grabbing 11 rebounds. Karlo Matkovic added 25 points with five threes. Ty Jerome scored 40 points with five threes for Memphis, but it wasn't enough. Memphis, now 6–1, led the NBA in net rating at +15.1 after two weeks. Jerome can become an unrestricted free agent next summer.
headlines.whyItMatters: Memphis is second in the West, behind Houston at 7–1, and it has the league's best net rating so far.

headlines.title: Fun, flowing, not yet flawless: Lakers' offence
headlines.summary: Luka Doncic scored 42 points with 13 assists and six threes as the Lakers beat Miami 138–117. The Lakers are second in scoring at 122.5 points per game and first in offensive rating at 121.9 per 100 possessions. Their starting group of Doncic, Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler, Ziaire Williams and Matisse Thybulle has the league's best offensive rating among five-man groups that have played at least 40 minutes. Quentin Grimes said the Lakers had 39 assists against Miami, the most under JJ Redick.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Lakers are 6–2 and fourth in the West. The team brought in nine new players, and the chemistry is still developing.

contextCard.title: How rookie-scale team options work
contextCard.body: A first-round pick's rookie contract can include a team option for an extra season, which the team must decide on by a set deadline. If the team picks it up, the player stays under his cheap rookie salary. If the team declines it, the player's contract ends after the current season. That's why this week's declined options matter, since they show which teams are letting young players go.
